narrative.overview: The back office is a well-run registrar's counter: papers stacked neatly, every form checked before it is stamped, the institution's colour on the letterhead and nowhere it does not belong. The system is flat, quiet and orderly: paper-white cards on a cool mist ground, separated by thin rules, never by shadows. Built first for non-technical Staff and for phones; the same stylesheet serves the Mini App.
keyCharacteristics: Calm and trustworthy: flat surfaces, thin rules, a single accent.
Easy on a phone: 48 px targets, stacked tables, one-column Mini App.
Institution-led colour: the brand is a variable; status colours are fixed.
System fonts with Thai fallbacks; no web fonts.

rules.name: The Letterhead Rule
rules.body: The institution colour lives on the letterhead (top bar) and on the one action that moves the work forward. It never fills large areas or decorates.

rules.name: The Fixed Status Rule
rules.body: Approved, refused and caution colours never follow the brand.

rules.name: The Tall Line Rule
rules.body: Body line height never drops below 1.6, headings never below 1.4; Thai stacked marks need the room.

rules.name: The Flat Counter Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit flat on the counter. If something needs attention, colour it; do not raise it.

dos: Do use --brand for the top bar and the primary action, --brand-text for links and --focus for the ring, and assume the brand can be any institution colour.
Do keep every interactive element at least 48 px tall and wide.
Do separate surfaces with Rule Line borders and tone, not shadows.
Do use the fixed status pairs (Approved, Refused, Caution) for every state message.
Do keep body line height at 1.6 for Thai.
Do use table.rows or .list for collections so phones get stacked cards.
Do give every home status card one state, one fact and one next action.
Do put raw technical details behind the ข้อมูลทางเทคนิค disclosure.
donts: Don't add box shadows or elevation.
Don't colour status messages with the brand colour.
Don't let any page scroll sideways at 360 px.
Don't fill large areas with the brand colour beyond the top bar.
Don't show the harpseal brand on Student-facing surfaces (chat, Mini App).
Don't turn the home into tiles of the navigation or a wall of vanity numbers.
